source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes let’s go. Anything else we should know about this place and the surrounding area?' accepts Fenar taking point, ordinary descent to entrance and asks Hessa for practical local context. Hessa voluntarily explains existing exterior maintenance ledge around abutment (narrow, alternate route, no claim safe unroped); warns old drains discharge by family's working landing and asks warning before any water controls operated. Local observable geography and livelihoods: wooded upland, scattered farms/grazing, small crossing serving local foot/pack/livestock traffic, not major commercial navigation; no new mapped settlements, faction, exact populations or ecological incidents claimed. Hessa stays outside dangerous entrance. Fenar leads V and Cirren down existing 30ft stairs to shadowed landing. Cirren compares visible carved lintel against familiar Vaishnavi survey/provenance marks: recognizable House name/designation establishes in-place association with Vaishnavi, inscription associates place with shelter/refuge; wording given as paraphrase, no invented exact ancient quotation or uncertain titulature decoded, no copy yet. Evidence from fixed prep and already known records, plain inspection; no roll required for core accessible evidence. The doorway's older promise of refuge contrasts visibly with later iron reinforcement and gouges. At the foot of the stair a dry rasp from inside and a hostile voice demanding purpose/authority are audible (first fixed custodian hears close party; language rendered as understood speech, no specific identity/knowledge of V, no magically sensed ancestry; no opening of barred receiving entry, no attack or surprise/initiative). Party stops at threshold for V decision. No paid guidance, lodging or ferrier commitment, no V speech beyond user words, no new resource expense, no full clearance or evidence copying. Day331~16:30.
